components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per area: Explore system, Sign in, Start tour.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #34e3b0; color: #06121a; font: 600 14px/1.4 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -8px #34e3b0; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34e3b0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #12293a; color: #97b7b8; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions: Reset view, Full screen, Explain.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #12293a; color: #e8fbf6; font: 500 14px/1.4 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid #1d3a4c; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #97b7b8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34e3b0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: System Search
components.description: The lead control on Home and Visual Learning.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input placeholder="Search any system: Uber, Netflix, WhatsApp…" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; color: #97b7b8; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-search input { width: 100%; background: #0b1d27; color: #e8fbf6; border: 1px solid #1d3a4c; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px 12px 44px; font: 400 15px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #34e3b0; }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #1d3a4c; color: #97b7b8; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px; font: 500 12px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #97b7b8; color: #e8fbf6; } .ds-chip-on { border-color: #34e3b0; background: #34e3b026; color: #e8fbf6; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Explanation, tour and parts columns; Home summaries.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-panel { background: #0b1d27; border: 1px solid #1d3a4c; border-radius: 12px; color: #e8fbf6; font: 400 15px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel header { padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1d3a4c; font: 600 14.4px 'Sora Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel div { padding: 16px; color: #97b7b8; }

components.name: Active Nav Item
components.description: Navigation item with the orbit-ring signature around its icon.
components.html: Visual Learning
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #12293a; color: #e8fbf6; font: 600 14px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ring { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; }

narrative.overview: Systems are constellations you explore. The app is a working tool first; the night palette, Sora display voice and the orbit-ring signature carry the world while every control stays familiar.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-black teal night with a matching day theme
One aurora-green accent for action and selection
Orbit ring as logo and active marker
3D stage stays night in both themes

rules.name: One aurora
rules.body: Aurora green marks only what you can act on or what is selected.

rules.name: Color encodes kind
rules.body: A 3D part's color is identical on its model, label, list number and panel header.

dos: Use Sora for titles and the wordmark, Figtree for everything else
Mark the active item with the orbit ring
donts: No gradient text or decorative glass
Keep space imagery to the logo, sign-in and 3D stage
